name: Neck Stretch
description: Gentle neck stretch: tip your head forward and slightly to one side, and let that hand add a light pull.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
cues: Pull gently; it should feel easy.
You'll feel it along the back of the opposite side of your neck.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Tilt and pull gently
keyframes.cue: Bend your head forward and slightly right, right hand gently drawing it down.
